items.name: in-app-ui
items.title: NocoBase In-app Notification UI
items.description: Application-owned personal inbox, unread count, and runtime Provider backed by the NocoBase in-app notification API.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-notification and @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app with the authenticated /api/notifications/in-app route. The installed source is application-owned; wire its Provider and page into the application until the plugins expose stable client contribution contracts.
